description: Truck tractor models. Reference consumption figures are comparative test results under specific conditions, NOT expected real-world consumption for agricultural haulage. Use estimatedConsumption (a configurable demo assumption) for calculations unless the user overrides it.

defaults.estimatedConsumptionNote: Demonstration assumption for loaded agricultural haulage. Real consumption depends on cargo weight, configuration, road, speed, terrain, weather, driver behaviour and number of stops. Override with your own fleet data.

green_truck_2025.name: Green Truck 2025 (VerkehrsRundschau / Trucker)
green_truck_2025.route: 343 km loop of motorways and country roads in southern Germany (Bavaria)
green_truck_2025.notes: Test combinations run at about 32 t GCW (not 40 t), with a 3-axle trailer. Ranking also considers AdBlue use, average speed and tractor unladen weight. Table values were seen in search-engine extracts; the Scania and DAF AdBlue and speed columns are tentative.
